# Elysiaa

> Elysiaa is the personal world and portfolio of Amirul Ikhwan (Kaiden-A), a Computer Science (AI) student and full-stack developer at International Islamic University Malaysia. Elysiaa is an abstract concept representing the hope of a better world.

## Identity

- Amirul Ikhwan is the full name.
- Kaiden-A is the online and programmer handle.
- Elysiaa is the name of the world and concept he builds under. It is not a separate person or a company.

## Selected projects

- [Atlas Sky](https://atlas.elysiaa.com/) - A star-map vault of the patterns, projects and playbooks behind his systems, generated from a plain-Markdown vault.
- [Secria](https://secria.elysiaa.com/) - A self-hosted secrets manager with envelope encryption, project-scoped access, audited reveals and a CLI-native workflow.
- [Elpis AI](https://elpis-dev.elysiaa.com/) - A fully agentic personal AI built on MCP tool calling.
- [KTAG Student Systems](https://ktag.upm.edu.my/) - Management and booking systems for Kolej Tan Sri Aishah Ghani, UPM.
